guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Management cautions that market conditions are uncertain and could change quickly. Based on today's assessment, management anticipates local currency sales for the fourth quarter of 2026 will increase approximately 5%. Adjusted EPS is forecast to be $14.84 to $15.04, a growth rate of 11% to 13%.

For the full year 2026, management anticipates local currency sales will increase approximately 5%, which excludes the impact of tariff refunds to customers. Adjusted EPS is forecast to be in the range of $47.70 to $47.90, representing growth of approximately 12%. This compares with previous local currency sales growth guidance of approximately 4% to 5% excluding tariff refunds and Adjusted EPS guidance of $47.15 to $47.50.

The Company stated that based on its assessment of market conditions today, management anticipates local currency sales growth of approximately 5% in 2027. This is expected to result in Adjusted EPS in the range of $52.50 to $53.50, representing growth of approximately 10% to 12%.

desk.headline: Sales up 6% to $1.09bn and adjusted EPS up 13% to $12.57, both beat; 2026 EPS outlook raised and 2027 outlook given
results: Sales rose 6% to $1.09bn (also 6% in local currency); adjusted EPS rose 13% to $12.57 and GAAP EPS 16% to $12.29.
Asia/Rest of World led with local-currency growth of 14%; the Americas grew 3% and Europe 2%.
Gross margin improved to 59.8% and adjusted operating profit rose 8% to $333.5m.
The company bought back $226m of shares in the quarter and $639m so far this year.

guidance.summary: Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $47.70–47.90 with sales growth now about 5%. For Q4 it expects about 5% sales growth, and for 2027 about 5% growth with EPS of $52.50–53.50.

points: China grew 13% in Q3; management expects only mid-single-digit China growth in 2027 given tougher comparisons.
Biopharma and biotech research improved, lifting liquid handling and pipettes; product inspection grew 8% organically.
Prices rose just over 2.5% in Q3; for 2027 the CFO assumes about 2% price and 3% volume growth.
The 2027 plan assumes tariff rates return to earlier levels; currency is a 1% sales headwind.
About $950m of free cash flow and $950m of share buybacks are planned for 2027.
